evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); called at 0073dafd with the boolean DAT_00f889a4 == 0. Sequence: base ctor 00a81480; vtable 00d5b44c; +0x174 = 0; operator new(0x10) with ctor 00a88650; BSP_SingletonLifetime_GetManager (00415350) then 00bd0d70; four dwords from DAT_01090ab0 vtable +0x14 copied to +0x118..+0x124; FMOD_EventSystem_Create (00c2df80) into +0x48; the handle's own function table slot 7 (+0x1c) into +0x44, which is the FMOD::System that every later import takes as its first stack argument. When +0x70 is set: getNumDrivers, then getDriverCaps counted down from numdrivers-1 to 0 writing +0x158/+0x15c and a stack speaker mode seeded with 1 at 00a88890, then setSpeakerMode with the value driver 0 left behind. +0x158 = 1 and +0x15c = 440000 are stored unconditionally afterwards, discarding the queried range. When +0x70 is clear: setOutput(2) = FMOD_OUTPUTTYPE_NOSOUND, the disabled-sound path. Then handle table slot 0 = init(maxchannels 0x200, flags 0x10, extradriverdata NULL, eventflags 0); setFileSystem(open 00a7d410, close 00a7b750, read 00a79930, seek 00a79970, blockalign 0); set3DSettings(dopplerscale DAT_00ce69c8 = 0.3f, distancefactor 1.0f, rolloffscale 1.0f); then getDriver, getOutput and getSpeakerMode into stack slots. Only the speaker mode is used: the eight-entry jump table at 00a88aac maps FMOD_SPEAKERMODE 1..6 onto +0x170 = 1..6, aliases 7 (SRS 5.1 matrix) onto 5 and leaves the field untouched for 0 (RAW). No setDriver call exists and no channel group is created here; the master channel group and the FMOD advanced settings belong to the follow-on stage 00a7ff80 called at 00a88a8e. The fmodex.dll imports are the mangled C++ methods with the QAG (public __stdcall) qualifier, so 'this' is pushed as the first stack argument. Every result is tested against 0x2b (FMOD_ERR_MEMORY) and nothing else; the handler is BSP_SoundSystem_ReportFmodMemoryFailure (00a7a460).
